import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize text labels: strip stray whitespace in sex (and other text cols)
    for col in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass: values recorded in milligrams (or with extra zeros)
    bm = df['body_mass_g']
    df['body_mass_g'] = np.where(bm > 6500, bm / 1000.0, bm)
    # Drop any body mass still outside plausible range
    df = df[df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
